messages.subject: rmarkdown stability on shiny server - tmp file
parts:
When I save a .Rmd file onto shiny server, the page will load two or three times but eventually I get this error:

path[1]="/tmp/RtmpnE8mE5/widgetbinding291e3fc5a2a1": No such file or directory


I have read this on SO (http://stackoverflow.com/questions/14458967/does-running-r-exe-create-temporary-files) which says that R
creates a temp file for each instance.

Is there some way to check if my .Rmd file is dependent on a temp file? Should this be possible? 

Are they any other things I should post to help with this?
